svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="UKdW2b16NERc70cx0FiK"> <mxGraphModel dx="2553" dy="1513" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title SecPipe Prototype 1 - Pipeline Execution Sequence

autoactivate on

actor User

participant \"SecPipe CLI\" as CLI
participant \"GraphRunner\" as Runner

participant \"SetupNode\" as Setup
participant \"ReconNode\" as Recon
participant \"ArchitectureSummaryNode\" as Summary
participant \"DetectNode\" as Detect
participant \"AnalyzerAdapters\" as Adapters
participant \"NormalizeNode\" as Normalize
participant \"HuntWaveNode\" as Hunt
participant \"CriticNode\" as Critic
participant \"NormalizeNode\n(re-entry)\" as NormalizeLLM
participant \"DeterministicRefuterNode\" as Refute
participant \"DisproverNode\" as Disprove
participant \"TestEvidenceNode\" as Evidence
participant \"ScoringNode\" as Score
participant \"RemediationLoopNode\" as Remediate
participant \"RecordVerifierNode\" as Verify
participant \"FinalizeNode\" as Finalize
participant \"ReportNode\" as Report

User -> CLI : Run scan command
CLI -> Runner : Start pipeline

Runner -> Setup : Initialize environment
Setup --> Runner : Environment + profile skeleton

Runner -> Recon : Discover architecture
Recon --> Runner : Profile + ledger units

Runner -> Summary : Generate architecture summary
Summary --> Runner : architecture.md

Runner -> Detect : Execute analyzers
Detect -> Adapters : Run configured analyzers
Adapters --> Detect : Candidates + coverage claims
Detect --> Runner : Candidates + ledger updates

Runner -> Normalize : Deduplicate findings
Normalize --> Runner : Normalized candidates

loop Hunt/Critic Coverage Loop

 Runner -> Hunt : Hunt uncovered attack surface
 Hunt --> Runner : NEXT or DONE

 alt Hunt returns NEXT

 Runner -> Critic : Evaluate coverage completeness
 Critic --> Runner : LOOP or DONE

 alt Critic returns LOOP: Missing coverage found, Return to Hunt

 else Critic retuns DONE: Coverage sufficient, Continue pipeline

 end

 else Hunt returns DONE: No remaining planned units or budget exhausted

 end

end

Runner -> NormalizeLLM : Normalize hunter findings
NormalizeLLM --> Runner : Merged candidates

Runner -> Refute : Deterministic validation
Refute --> Runner : Rejected findings

Runner -> Disprove : Attempt disproval
Disprove --> Runner : Survivor drafts

Runner -> Evidence : Generate validation evidence
Evidence --> Runner : Confirmed findings

Runner -> Score : Assign severity and confidence
Score --> Runner : Scored records

Runner -> Remediate : Generate remediation patches
Remediate --> Runner : Remediation status

Runner -> Verify : Verify records
Verify --> Runner : Verified records

Runner -> Finalize : Validate final state
Finalize --> Runner : Terminal state + counts

Runner -> Report : Generate reports
Report --> Runner : Output artifacts

note right of Report
findings.json
coverage-ledger.json
run-metadata.json
secpipe.sarif
report.html
pr-comment.md
metrics.json
end note

Runner --> CLI : Final pipeline state
CLI --> User : Display results

@enduml",
